title: Rolling Item-Refund Limits Across a Customer's Cartwise Grocery Orders
content:
## Desk rule — item refunds weighed across all of a customer's orders

This desk rule governs how item refunds on Cartwise Grocery Orders are weighed against the customer's refund history across every order they hold.

### Rule in force

1. Item refunds are judged across all of a customer's orders as well as per order.
2. Substitution price protection refunds, weight overage refunds, substitution rejection refunds, alcohol refunds and returned-order refunds do not count toward, and do not depend on, the rolling limits.

### Retired clauses

The following two clauses of this rule are **no longer in force**; each is superseded by the current basis and is kept here only so the record of the rule is complete.

- *Retired, no longer in force:* a new missing, damaged, wrong item or quality refund may be granted by the agent only while the customer's rolling 90-day count of such refunds is below the service level's rolling refund-count limit and the rolling 90-day amount of such refunds plus the requested amount does not exceed the service level's rolling refund-amount limit, both taken from the service level of the order being refunded.
- *Retired, no longer in force:* when either limit would be crossed, no refund is booked; the request is registered for review as a rolling-limit review and the review team decides it.

### What the rolling figures measure

The two rolling figures of Cartwise Grocery Orders are read from the customer's order entries, across all of the customer's orders, not only the order in question:

- **Rolling refund count** — the number of item refunds with the reason missing, damaged, wrong item or quality, dated within the rolling 90 calendar days ending today, counted by the refund date.
- **Rolling refund amount** — the total amount of those same item refunds within the same rolling 90 calendar days.

### Which refunds enter the rolling figures

| Refund reason on the item refund | Counts toward the rolling figures |
|---|---|
| Missing | Yes |
| Damaged | Yes |
| Wrong item | Yes |
| Quality | Yes |
| Substitution price protection | No |
| Weight overage | No |
| Substitution rejected | No |
| Alcohol ID failed | No |
| Returned order | No |

### Points of judgement

- *A weight overage refund booked on another order last week* — it neither adds to the rolling count nor to the rolling amount (item 2).
- *Two quality refunds on two different orders, both within the last 90 calendar days* — both count, because the figures are taken across all of the customer's orders (item 1 and the definitions above).
- *A missing refund dated more than 90 calendar days before today* — it falls outside the rolling window and does not enter either figure.

superseded_clauses: A new missing, damaged, wrong_item or quality refund may be granted by the agent only while order_msr_refund_count_90d is below refund_count_90d_limit and order_msr_refund_amount_90d plus the requested amount does not exceed refund_amount_90d_limit_usd, both taken from the service level of the order being refunded.
When either limit would be crossed, no refund is booked; the request is registered for review with request_type refund_limit_review and the review team decides it.
